hypothesis: Random nearby perturbations of a pretrained VLM yield materially better held-out visual line-tracing experts without gradients.
perturbation: Unchanged pinned RandOpt apply_perturbation with PERTURB_VISUAL=1: all parameters including vision and language, native tensor layout, randopt-per-tensor-v1, exact snapshot anchoring. No parameter localization or change after calibration.
cache_contract: Prefix caching disabled; multimodal processor cache disabled; all requests drain and model-dependent encoder cache is cleared before each generation.

baseline.rule: Evaluate the entire base first. Inspect geometry and automatic format failures; if either split is outside [15%,90%], repair the benchmark before candidates and preserve every baseline/dataset version. No generator, prompt, parser or task changes after the first calibration candidate. Base-only held-out inspection is the user's explicit baseline-first exception and never enters sigma/ranking.

calibration.seed_rule: 20 distinct seeds per sigma; sigma index*20 + offset + seed_start; no reuse in final search
calibration.catastrophic_rule: accuracy <= max(0.15, base_accuracy - 0.20), or invalid-answer fraction >=0.50
calibration.scale_failure_rule: A sigma is scale-failed if mean accuracy <=0.275 and best accuracy <=0.40 (approximately chance), or catastrophic fraction >=0.80. If all three fail, STOP operationally; do not claim scientific NO or add sigmas.
calibration.sigma_choice: highest best selection correct count, then greatest fraction strictly beating base, then smaller sigma

search.seed_rule: seed_start + i, i=0..299; disjoint from all calibration seeds
search.ranking: selection correct count descending, then SHA256(visual-rank-v1:<candidate_id>) ascending
search.freeze: Commit exact best/top5/top10 identities and state fingerprints before candidate held-out generation; calibration candidates cannot enter final ranking

heldout.candidates: only the frozen top10 union plus base
heldout.voting: Ignore invalid answers; Counter majority with ties broken by first occurrence in frozen individual ranking; all-invalid is incorrect

gate.difficulty_rule: The same qualifying best/top5/top10 method must have strictly positive accuracy gain in at least two of easy/medium/hard, including medium or hard. No requirement is tuned using candidate outcomes.
gate.rule: GO if best improves >=5pp OR top5/top10 vote improves >=7pp, with the same method satisfying the difficulty rule and all controls/disjointness. Otherwise NO-GO for this setup. Operational or scale failure is not a scientific NO.

controls: zero perturbation equals base on both splits
one repeated calibration candidate per sigma
selected candidate fingerprints match search before held-out generation
one repeated selected candidate on held-out
ranking code only accepts selection records
uncertainty: Descriptive paired question bootstrap: 10000 replicates, seed 20261003; does not change fixed point-estimate gate. Expert density is descriptive selection-set frequency, not unbiased held-out density.
stop: One baseline-valid frozen dataset; at most 60 calibration candidates and exactly 300 final selection candidates; evaluate only selected top10 on held-out. No rescue tuning, extra population, model switch, geometry change or follow-on optimizer.
